'''Linsu''', also called Grandma Lin, is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]]. 

==Profile==
She is the fourth and current owner of Bogu's Arbor, a penjing shop. [[Verina]] and [[Rongqing]] help her with the store.

She is the mother of [[Linling]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Linsu:''' Welcome to Bogu's Arbor. Take your time to look around.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Linsu:''' Hello dear, come choose a {{Rubi|penjing|bonsai}} for yourself. Not only do they add a touch of green to your space, but they also freshen up the air!
::'''Linsu:''' Don't worry, even if you're not buying anything, I'm always happy to have company.
:{{DIcon}} About the Arbor
::'''Linsu:''' This penjing shop? It's been around for ages. I'm actually the fourth owner.
::'''Linsu:''' My daughter Linling, well, she's got her own dreams and doesn't seem to be interested in taking over the shop.
::'''Linsu:''' Let her be. I'm still feeling fine. I'm still going strong. As long as I can keep moving around, this shop won't close.
:{{DIcon}} About Ronqing
::'''Linsu:''' Rongqing? Oh, he's been a regular at my shop since before he started helping out here.
::'''Linsu:''' He's studying penjing design and thought interning here would be a good fit.
::'''Linsu:''' I agreed because I could tell by the way he looked at the penjings.... Such passion and sincerity in his eyes.
::'''Linsu:''' It's great to see that kind of dedication. Though, he does tend to go a bit overboard with decorations sometimes. Miniature models, amber pebbles... you name it.
::'''Linsu:''' But aiming for perfection isn't a bad thing. Hopefully, he'll refine his style as he learns more about penjing design.
:{{DIcon}} About Verina
::'''Linsu:''' Little Verina? She is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
::'''Linsu:''' She has been a great help. She knows a lot about everything plant-related.
::'''Linsu:''' All her penjings are something else! So vibrant and enchanting.
::'''Linsu:''' If only she were my granddaughter...
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* Penjing, also known as penzai, is the ancient Chinese art of depicting artistically formed trees, other plants, and landscapes in miniature. It is the similar practice of Bonsai, but aims for a more natural and landscape sense in design.
